sourceTitle.zh: 卷一百二十七 載記第二十七 慕容德

assignment: Review every listed Chinese unit against both English fields. Check proposition coverage, names, kinship, attribution, events and repeated uses. Return assessed IDs and each definite defect as a complete before/after field replacement with source reason. Preserve gaps explicitly. This part grants no date, identity or chapter approval.

units.zh: 而百姓因秦、晉之弊，迭相陰憲，或百室合戶，或千丁共籍，依託城社，不懼燻燒，公避課役，擅為奸宄，損風毀憲，法所不容，但檢今未宣，弗可加戮。
units.en: Yet the common people, inheriting the harm of Qin and Jin, successively conspire in shadow; some hundred households share one register, some thousand adult males share one roll, relying on altars of soil and grain and fearing no burning, publicly avoiding taxes and labor, recklessly acting treacherous, harming custom and destroying statutes—what the law cannot tolerate—but because inspection has not yet been proclaimed, we cannot yet add execution.
units.literal: Yet the common people, inheriting the harm of Qin and Jin, successively conspire in shadow; some hundred households share one register, some thousand adult males share one roll, relying on altars of soil and grain and fearing no burning, publicly avoiding taxes and labor, recklessly acting treacherous, harming custom and destroying statutes—what the law cannot tolerate—but because inspection has not yet been proclaimed, we cannot yet add execution.

units.zh: 今宜隱實黎萌，正其編貫，庶上增皇朝理物之明，下益軍國兵資之用。
units.en: Now it is fitting to reveal the truth about the common folk, correct their household rolls, so above we increase the court's clarity in ordering things, below we add to army and state use of soldiers and supplies.
units.literal: Now it is fitting to reveal the truth about the common folk, correct their household rolls, so above we increase the court's clarity in ordering things, below we add to army and state use of soldiers and supplies.

units.zh: 若蒙採納，冀裨山海，雖遇商鞅之刑，悅綰之害，所不辭也。」
units.en: If this is adopted, I hope it will add even a little to mountains and seas. Though I meet Shang Yang’s punishment or Yue Wan’s harm, I will not decline.”
units.literal: If this is adopted, I hope it will add even a little to mountains and seas. Though I meet Shang Yang’s punishment or Yue Wan’s harm, I will not decline.”

units.zh: 德納之，遣其車騎將軍慕容鎮率騎三千，緣邊嚴防，備百姓逃竄。
units.en: Murong De agreed and sent Murong Zhen to seal the frontier against flight.
units.literal: De accepted it and sent chariot-and-cavalry general Murong Zhen with three thousand horse to patrol the border strictly and guard against commoners fleeing.

units.zh: 以𧨳為使持節、散騎常侍、行台尚書，巡郡縣隱實，得廕戶五萬八千。
units.en: He named Han Fan inspector and uncovered fifty-eight thousand concealed households.
units.literal: He appointed Han Fan as commissioner bearing credentials, regular attendant for scattered cavalry, acting director of the traveling headquarters, to tour commanderies and counties and reveal truth, obtaining fifty-eight thousand hidden households.

units.zh: 𧨳公廉正直，所在野次，人不擾焉。
units.en: Han Fan camped in the fields and never troubled the locals.
units.literal: Han Fan was fair, incorrupt, and upright; wherever he went he camped in the open and people were not disturbed.

units.zh: 德大集諸生，親臨策試。
units.en: Murong De convened the academy and presided over the examinations himself.
units.literal: De greatly gathered the students and personally attended the policy examination.

units.zh: 既而饗宴，乘高遠矚，顧謂其尚書魯邃曰：「齊、魯固多君子，當昔全盛之時，接、慎、巴生、淳于、鄒、田之徒，廕修簷，臨清沼，馳硃輪，佩長劍，恣非馬之雄辭，奮談天之逸辯，指麾則紅紫成章，俯仰則丘陵生韻，至於今日，荒草頹墳，氣消煙滅，永言千載，能不依然！」
units.en: Presently he feasted, rode high and looked far, and said to his minister Lu Sui, 'Qi and Lu surely had many gentlemen; in their full splendor men like Jie, Shen, Ba Sheng, Chunyu, Zou, and Tian sheltered under broad eaves, leaned on clear pools, raced vermillion wheels, wore long swords, vented heroic rhetoric, raised heaven-storming debate, gestured and purple and red formed patterns, bowed and hills and mounds took rhythm; down to today wild grass and ruined tombs, breath gone smoke extinguished—speaking of a thousand years, how can one not be moved!'
units.literal: Presently he feasted, rode high and looked far, and said to his minister Lu Sui, 'Qi and Lu surely had many gentlemen; in their full splendor men like Jie, Shen, Ba Sheng, Chunyu, Zou, and Tian sheltered under broad eaves, leaned on clear pools, raced vermillion wheels, wore long swords, vented heroic rhetoric, raised heaven-storming debate, gestured and purple and red formed patterns, bowed and hills and mounds took rhythm; down to today wild grass and ruined tombs, breath gone smoke extinguished—speaking of a thousand years, how can one not be moved!'

units.zh: 邃答曰：「武王封比干之墓，漢祖祭信陵之墳，皆留心賢哲，每懷往事。
units.en: Sui replied, 'King Wu of Zhou closed Bi Gan's tomb, Han's Gaozu sacrificed at Lord Xinling's grave—both fixed their hearts on worthies and often cherished old deeds.
units.literal: Sui replied, 'King Wu of Zhou closed Bi Gan's tomb, Han's Gaozu sacrificed at Lord Xinling's grave—both fixed their hearts on worthies and often cherished old deeds.

units.zh: 陛下慈深二主，澤被九泉，若使彼而有知，寧不銜荷矣。」
units.en: Your Majesty's kindness runs deeper than those two lords, your grace reaches the nine springs; if they had consciousness, how would they not bear gratitude in their mouths!'
units.literal: Your Majesty's kindness runs deeper than those two lords, your grace reaches the nine springs; if they had consciousness, how would they not bear gratitude in their mouths!'

units.zh: 先是，妖賊王始聚眾於太山，自稱太平皇帝，號其父為太上皇，兄為征東將軍，弟征西將軍。
units.en: A charlatan named Wang Shi had declared himself emperor on Mount Tai with a full family of bogus titles.
units.literal: Earlier, demon bandit Wang Shi gathered a host at Mount Tai, styled himself emperor of Great Peace, titled his father retired emperor, elder brother general who campaigns east, younger brother general who campaigns west.

units.zh: 慕容鎮討擒之，斬於都市。
units.en: Murong Zhen took him and executed him publicly.
units.literal: Murong Zhen campaigned, captured him, and beheaded him in the great market.

units.zh: 臨刑，或問其父及兄弟所在，始答曰：「太上皇帝蒙塵於外，征東、征西亂兵所害。
units.en: At execution someone asked where his father and brothers were; Shi answered, 'The retired emperor wanders in dust without, the east and west generals were killed by mutinous troops.
units.literal: At execution someone asked where his father and brothers were; Shi answered, 'The retired emperor wanders in dust without, the east and west generals were killed by mutinous troops.

units.zh: 惟朕一身，獨無聊賴。」
units.en: Only I alone remain, utterly without support.'
units.literal: Only I alone remain, utterly without support.'

units.zh: 其妻怒之曰：「止坐此口，以至於此，奈何復爾！」
units.en: His wife angrily said, 'It is only because of this mouth that you reached this; how can you do it again!'
units.literal: His wife angrily said, 'It is only because of this mouth that you reached this; how can you do it again!'

units.zh: 始曰：「皇后！
units.en: Shi said, 'Empress!
units.literal: Shi said, 'Empress!

units.zh: 自古豈有不破之家，不亡之國邪！」
units.en: From antiquity has there been a house that never broke, a state that never perished!'
units.literal: From antiquity has there been a house that never broke, a state that never perished!'

units.zh: 行刑者以刀環築之，仰視曰：「崩即崩矣，終不改帝號。」
units.en: The executioner struck him with the ring of the blade; looking up he said, 'Collapse it may collapse, I will never change the imperial title.'
units.literal: The executioner struck him with the ring of the blade; looking up he said, 'Collapse it may collapse, I will never change the imperial title.'

units.zh: 德聞而哂之。
units.en: Murong De only laughed.
units.literal: De heard and sneered.

units.zh: 時桓玄將行篡逆，誅不附己者。
units.en: When Huan Xuan prepared his coup he purged dissenters.
units.literal: At that time Huan Xuan was about to carry out usurpation and killed those who would not attach to him.

units.zh: 冀州刺史劉軌、襄城太守司馬休之、征虜將軍劉敬宣、廣陵相高雅之、江都長張誕並內不自安，皆奔於德。
units.en: Liu Gui, inspector of Ji Province; Sima Xiuzhi, governor of Xiangcheng; Liu Jingxuan, General Who Conquers Caitiffs; Gao Yazhi, chancellor of Guangling; and Zhang Dan, magistrate of Jiangdu, all felt unsafe within Jin territory and fled to Murong De.
units.literal: Ji Province inspector Liu Gui, Xiangcheng prefect Sima Xiuzhi, general who captures barbarians Liu Jingxuan, Guangling chancellor Gao Yazhi, and Jiangdu magistrate Zhang Dan all felt insecure within and fled to De.

units.zh: 於是德中書侍郎韓范上疏曰：「夫帝王之道，必崇經略。
units.en: Thereupon De's palace aide Han Fan submitted a memorial saying, 'The way of emperors and kings must honor planning and strategy.
units.literal: Thereupon De's palace aide Han Fan submitted a memorial saying, 'The way of emperors and kings must honor planning and strategy.

units.zh: 有其時無其人，則弘濟之功闕；
units.en: Having the time without the man, then the work of great rescue is lacking;
units.literal: Having the time without the man, then the work of great rescue is lacking;

units.zh: 有其人無其時，則英武之志不申。
units.en: Having the man without the time, then heroic martial intent is not displayed.
units.literal: Having the man without the time, then heroic martial intent is not displayed.

units.zh: 至於能成王業者，惟人時合也。
units.en: As for those able to complete kingly work, only when man and time align.
units.literal: As for those able to complete kingly work, only when man and time align.

units.zh: 自晉國內難，七載於茲。
units.en: Since Jin's internal disaster, seven years have passed here.
units.literal: Since Jin's internal disaster, seven years have passed here.

units.zh: 桓玄逆篡，虐逾董卓，神怒人怨，其殃積矣。
units.en: Huan Xuan usurped in rebellion, his cruelty surpassing Dong Zhuo; gods angry and men resentful, his calamities are piled.
units.literal: Huan Xuan usurped in rebellion, his cruelty surpassing Dong Zhuo; gods angry and men resentful, his calamities are piled.

units.zh: 可乘之機，莫過此也。
units.en: A chance to strike exceeds none other than this.
units.literal: A chance to strike exceeds none other than this.

units.zh: 以陛下之神武，經而緯之，驅樂奮之卒，接厭亂之機，譬猶聲發回應，形動影隨，未足比其易也。
units.en: With Your Majesty's divine martial quality, ordering warp and weft, driving troops eager for joy, joining a world weary of chaos, it is like sound issuing and echo answering, form moving and shadow following—not enough to compare its ease.
units.literal: With Your Majesty's divine martial quality, ordering warp and weft, driving troops eager for joy, joining a world weary of chaos, it is like sound issuing and echo answering, form moving and shadow following—not enough to compare its ease.

units.zh: 且江、淮南北戶口未幾，公私戎馬不過數百，守備之事蓋亦微矣。
units.en: Moreover north and south of the Yangzi and Huai households are still few; public and private war horses number only in the hundreds; matters of defense are also slight.
units.literal: Moreover north and south of the Yangzi and Huai households are still few; public and private war horses number only in the hundreds; matters of defense are also slight.

units.zh: 若以步騎一萬，建雷霆之舉，卷甲長驅，指臨江、會，必望旗草偃，壺漿屬路。
units.en: If with ten thousand foot and horse we raise a thunderstroke, roll armor in a long drive, point to Linjiang and Kuaiji, they are sure to lower banners like grass bending, and jars of broth will line the road.
units.literal: If with ten thousand foot and horse we raise a thunderstroke, roll armor in a long drive, point to Linjiang and Kuaiji, they are sure to lower banners like grass bending, and jars of broth will line the road.

units.zh: 跨地數千，眾逾十萬，可以西並強秦，北抗大魏。
units.en: Spanning several thousand li, hosts exceeding a hundred thousand, we could west merge with strong Qin and north resist Great Wei.
units.literal: Spanning several thousand li, hosts exceeding a hundred thousand, we could west merge with strong Qin and north resist Great Wei.

units.zh: 夫欲拓境開疆，保寧社稷，無過今也。
units.en: For desiring to widen territory and open frontiers, guarding altars of soil and grain, nothing surpasses now.
units.literal: For desiring to widen territory and open frontiers, guarding altars of soil and grain, nothing surpasses now.

units.zh: 如使後機失會，豪桀復起，梟除桓玄，布惟新之化，遐邇既寧，物無異望，非但建鄴難屠，江北亦不可冀。
units.en: If afterward the opportunity slips and heroes rise again, when Huan Xuan is cut off and only fresh reform spreads, far and near already calm and things without other hope, not only Jiankang will be hard to butcher, the north of the river also cannot be hoped for.
units.literal: If afterward the opportunity slips and heroes rise again, when Huan Xuan is cut off and only fresh reform spreads, far and near already calm and things without other hope, not only Jiankang will be hard to butcher, the north of the river also cannot be hoped for.

units.zh: 機過患生，憂必至矣。
units.en: When the opportunity passes, calamity arises; worry is sure to arrive.
units.literal: When the opportunity passes, calamity arises; worry is sure to arrive.

units.zh: 天與不取，悔將及焉。
units.en: Heaven gives and we do not take; regret will reach us.
units.literal: Heaven gives and we do not take; regret will reach us.

units.zh: 惟陛下覽之。」
units.en: Only may Your Majesty consider it.'
units.literal: Only may Your Majesty consider it.'

units.zh: 德曰：「自頃數纏百六，宏綱暫弛，遂令奸逆亂華，舊京墟穢，每尋否運，憤慨兼懷。
units.en: De said, 'Recently fate has repeatedly tangled in misfortune, the great net hung slack, letting treacherous rebels disorder the Hua heartland and the old capital lie in filth; each time I ponder this ill fortune, indignation fills my breast.
units.literal: De said, 'Recently fate has repeatedly tangled in misfortune, the great net hung slack, letting treacherous rebels disorder the Hua heartland and the old capital lie in filth; each time I ponder this ill fortune, indignation fills my breast.

units.zh: 昔少康以一旅之眾，復夏配天，況朕據三齊之地，藉五州之眾，教之以軍旅，訓之以禮讓，上下知義，人思自奮，繕甲待釁，為日久矣。
units.en: Formerly Shaokang with one brigade's host restored Xia and matched Heaven; how much more I occupy the land of the three Qi, rely on the hosts of five provinces, teach them with armies, train them with ritual yielding; above and below know righteousness, each man thinks to rouse himself; we repair armor and await a crack—this has been long.
units.literal: Formerly Shaokang with one brigade's host restored Xia and matched Heaven; how much more I occupy the land of the three Qi, rely on the hosts of five provinces, teach them with armies, train them with ritual yielding; above and below know righteousness, each man thinks to rouse himself; we repair armor and await a crack—this has been long.

units.zh: 但欲先定中原，掃除逋孽，然後宣佈淳風，經理九服，飲馬長江，懸旌隴阪。
units.en: But I wish first to settle the central plain, sweep away fleeing villains, then spread pure wind, order the nine domains, drink horses at the Yangzi, hang banners on the Long slopes.
units.literal: But I wish first to settle the central plain, sweep away fleeing villains, then spread pure wind, order the nine domains, drink horses at the Yangzi, hang banners on the Long slopes.

units.zh: 此志未遂，且韜戈耳。
units.en: This intent is not yet fulfilled; for now we sheathe the spears only.
units.literal: This intent is not yet fulfilled; for now we sheathe the spears only.

units.zh: 今者之事，王公其詳議之。」
units.en: As for today's matter, let the royal dukes deliberate in detail.'
units.literal: As for today's matter, let the royal dukes deliberate in detail.'

units.zh: 咸以桓玄新得志，未可圖，乃止。
units.en: The court judged Huan Xuan too strong for the moment and dropped the idea.
units.literal: All thought Huan Xuan newly triumphant and not yet to be plotted against, and therefore stopped.

units.zh: 於是講武於城西，步兵三十七萬，車一萬七千乘，鐵騎五萬三千，周亙山澤，旌旗彌漫，鉦鼓之聲，振動天地。
units.en: He staged a review west of the city with hundreds of thousands on parade.
units.literal: Thereupon he drilled troops west of the city: three hundred seventy thousand foot, seventeen thousand carts, fifty-three thousand armored horse, filling mountains and marshes, banners covering heaven, the clash of gongs and drums shaking heaven and earth.

units.zh: 德登高望之，顧謂劉軌、高雅之曰：「昔郤克仇齊，子胥怨楚，終能暢其剛烈，名流千載。
units.en: De climbed high and looked over them, and said to Liu Gui and Gao Yazhi, 'Formerly Xi Ke avenged Qi, Wu Zixu resented Chu, and in the end they could vent their fierce integrity and their names flow a thousand years.
units.literal: De climbed high and looked over them, and said to Liu Gui and Gao Yazhi, 'Formerly Xi Ke avenged Qi, Wu Zixu resented Chu, and in the end they could vent their fierce integrity and their names flow a thousand years.

units.zh: 卿等既知投身有道，當使無慚昔人也。」
units.en: You gentlemen already know to cast yourselves onto a rightful way; you should make yourselves not ashamed before the ancients.'
units.literal: You gentlemen already know to cast yourselves onto a rightful way; you should make yourselves not ashamed before the ancients.'

units.zh: 雅之等頓首答曰：「幸蒙陛下天覆之恩，大造之澤，存亡繼絕，實在聖時，雖則萬隕，何以上報！」
units.en: Yazhi and the others bowed their heads to the ground and replied: “We have fortunately received Your Majesty’s heaven-covering grace and great creative favor, preserving the dying and continuing the cut off. Truly this lies in a sage age; even if we fell ten thousand times, how could we repay it above!”
units.literal: Yazhi and the others bowed their heads to the ground and replied: “We have fortunately received Your Majesty’s heaven-covering grace and great creative favor, preserving the dying and continuing the cut off. Truly this lies in a sage age; even if we fell ten thousand times, how could we repay it above!”

units.zh: 俄聞桓玄敗，德以慕容鎮為前鋒，慕容鐘為大都督，配以步卒二萬，騎五千，克期將發，而德寢疾，於是罷兵。
units.en: Soon they heard Huan Xuan was defeated; Murong De made Murong Zhen the vanguard and Murong Zhong supreme commander, assigning twenty thousand foot and five thousand horse with a set departure date, but Murong De fell ill and therefore halted the army.
units.literal: Soon they heard Huan Xuan was defeated; De made Murong Zhen vanguard and Murong Zhong supreme commander, pairing them with twenty thousand foot and five thousand horse, fixing a date to set out, but De took to bed ill, and therefore the army was halted.

units.zh: 初，德迎其兄子超于長安，及是而至。
units.en: Murong Chao, his elder brother's son, whom he had summoned from Chang'an, now arrived.
units.literal: Earlier, De had summoned his elder brother's son Chao from Chang'an; at this point he arrived.

units.zh: 德夜夢其父曰：「汝既無子，何不早立超為太子，不爾，惡人生心。」
units.en: De dreamed at night his father said, 'You have no son; why not early establish Chao as crown prince—otherwise evil men will breed designs.'
units.literal: De dreamed at night his father said, 'You have no son; why not early establish Chao as crown prince—otherwise evil men will breed designs.'

units.zh: 寐而告其妻曰：「先帝神明所敕，觀此夢意，吾將死矣。」
units.en: Awake he told his wife, 'The late emperor's spirit commanded; looking at this dream's meaning, I am about to die.'
units.literal: Awake he told his wife, 'The late emperor's spirit commanded; looking at this dream's meaning, I am about to die.'

units.zh: 乃下書以超為皇太子，大赦境內，子為父後者人爵二級。
units.en: He issued an edict naming Murong Chao crown prince, proclaimed a general amnesty within his realm, and raised by two degrees the rank of every son who was his father’s heir.
units.literal: Thereupon he issued an edict making Chao crown prince, amnestied the realm, and for sons continuing fathers raised each man's rank two grades.

units.zh: 其月死，即義熙元年也，時年七十。
units.en: He died the same month, in the first year of Yixi, at seventy sui.
units.literal: That month he died; it was the first year of Yixi, and at the time his age was seventy sui.

units.zh: 乃夜為十餘棺，分出四門，潛葬山谷，竟不知其屍之所在。
units.en: They ran decoy coffers out each gate and hid his true burial in the hills.
units.literal: That night they made more than ten coffins, sent them out the four gates separately, and secretly buried him in mountain valleys; in the end none knew where his corpse lay.

units.zh: 在位五年。
units.en: His reign lasted five years.
units.literal: He held the throne five years.

units.zh: 偽諡獻武皇帝。
units.en: His temple posthumous title was Emperor Xianwu.
units.literal: He was posthumously titled Emperor Xianwu.
